svg.title: Predicted 1H NMR and FTIR of PE-EO-(HDI)4 and GE-EO-(HDI)3
svg.desc: Predicted proton NMR in CDCl3 with peaks a to i assigned to the urethane-capped arm, and predicted ATR-FTIR with key bands, for the 4-arm and 3-arm NCO-terminated prepolymers.
svg.text: Predicted spectra of the two NCO-terminated prepolymers
Prediction from typical literature shifts/bands for HDI-urethane-capped PEG polyols - simulated line shapes, schematic intensities, not measured data.
PE-EO-(HDI)4 (4-arm; example n = 3.75 EO/arm, PE-EO Mn ~ 800)
GE-EO-(HDI)3 (3-arm; example n = 6.9 EO/arm, GE-EO Mn ~ 1000)
PE-EO polyol before reaction (IR panel only)
(the first CH2 is part of the core;

g.title: d core: PE C(CH2O)4, s, 8H (3.42 s ppm)
d core: glycerol CH + 2 CH2, 5H, under c (3.45-3.62 ppm)

svg.text: urethane N-H (shift depends on concentration / H-bonding)
core: C(CH2O)4 singlet (PE) vs glycerol CH + 2 CH2, buried under c (GE)
Full capping: b : f = 1 : 1 and, for PE, b : d = 1 : 1 (8H : 8H). Unreacted ends show HO-CH2 ~3.72 t and no matching b.
Free HDI removed: e : f = 1 : 1 (excess HDI adds to e at 3.30 and to g / i, not to f, a or b).
PE vs GE: only PE-EO-(HDI)4 gives the isolated core singlet d (3.42); GE core signals hide under the PEG envelope c.
Moisture side product: disubstituted urea would add a broad NH ~4.3-4.6 ppm and an extra NHCH2 near 3.13 ppm.

g.title: polyol O-H stretch - must vanish when every OH is capped
urethane N-H stretch (H-bonded), free N-H shoulder ~3440
isocyanate N=C=O asymmetric stretch - very strong, the NCO end groups (free HDI absorbs here too)
C-O-C ether stretch of the EO chains (strongest band)

svg.text: Key change: the broad O-H band (3450) disappears while N-H (3330), C=O (1718) and amide II (1530) appear - every OH became a urethane.
NCO content: 2270 cm-1 tracks free NCO end groups; relative to the 1100 C-O-C band it is weaker for GE-EO-(HDI)3 (longer EO arms, fewer NCO per mass).
Limitation: FTIR cannot tell end-capped NCO from leftover HDI (both at 2270) - use the NMR ratio e : f or titration (ASTM D2572) for %NCO.
